A single-name SERVICE filter can miss part of the bill, and the token model will then look like it overshoots. Omit the SERVICE filter when filtering by product attributes, or list the names first with `ce:GetDimensionValues` (`Dimension = SERVICE`, `SearchString = Bedrock`) and include all of them. (2) Requests that fail **before Bedrock determines the target model** are published **without** the `ModelId` dimension.
